description: Client-side redline playbook for mutual NDAs. All citations trace to the firm's clause library.

clauses.match_text: laws of the State of Delaware
clauses.replacement_text: laws of the State of California
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause GL-001: Governing Law (California)
clauses.rationale: Client is CA-based; CA law provides familiar precedent and convenient forum.

clauses.match_text: Liability is unlimited for all claims arising under this Agreement.
clauses.replacement_text: Each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the total amount of fees paid or payable by the receiving Party in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, excluding liability for gross negligence, willful misconduct, and breach of confidentiality obligations.
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause LC-003: Limitation of Liability (Capped with Carve-outs)
clauses.rationale: Cap liability at prior 12 months fees with standard carve-outs for gross negligence, willful misconduct, and confidentiality breaches.

clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause TN-004: Termination Notice (30 Days Written)
clauses.rationale: Reduce notice period from 90 to 30 days for flexibility; require written notice for audit trail.

clauses.match_text: survive termination of this Agreement for five years
clauses.replacement_text: survive termination of this Agreement for three (3) years
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause CS-005: Confidentiality Survival (3 Years)
clauses.rationale: Reduce survival period from 5 to 3 years; industry standard for technology NDAs.

clauses.match_text: The indemnifying Party’s total liability for indemnification shall be unlimited.
clauses.replacement_text: The indemnifying Party’s total liability for indemnification shall not exceed the fees paid by the indemnifying Party in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, except for indemnification obligations arising from third-party IP infringement claims.
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause IC-006: Indemnification Cap (12-Month Fees with IP Carve-out)
clauses.rationale: Cap indemnification at 12 months fees with carve-out for IP infringement claims, which are typically uncapped.
